component.name: Wheelguard
component.summary: Scroll bounce filter and advanced settings for your mouse

description.p: Wheelguard drops the bouncing, wrong-direction scroll-wheel ticks of a faulty encoder on GNOME, with a live view of the wheel. It also edits the on-board settings of the Endgame Gear XM2w 4k v2 (DPI, polling rate, lift-off distance, button filtering, sleep timers and battery), the Logitech G Pro X Superlight (DPI stages, polling rate, battery) and the Razer DeathAdder V4 Pro (DPI stages, polling rate up to 8000 Hz, sleep timer, low-battery warning, battery), and the GNOME pointer settings. Not affiliated with Endgame Gear, Logitech or Razer.

screenshot.caption: Scroll protection with the live wheel monitor
The mouse's own settings: battery, DPI stages and more

ul.li: Per-game profiles: pick an app, such as a game, and Wheelguard switches scroll protection, Click-Lock and the DPI stage while it is in front, then back to your settings
Double-click fix: ignores the extra click a worn mouse button sends, for every mouse
Scroll protection works with any mouse that has a wheel; pick it in the new Mouse box
Wheel health: a 7 and 30 day chart of how often the wheel needed blocking, with a warning if it starts bouncing more
Click-Lock lets go by itself after 10 minutes (adjustable), and when the computer sleeps or the screen locks
Click-Lock in Repeat mode no longer starts while you are dragging
Low-battery alerts at 20% and 5%, with an amber dot on the panel icon
Keyboard shortcuts for Click-Lock and the next DPI stage, added from the About page
A drawing of your mouse on the Mouse page that lights up the button you are editing
A short welcome for new users that checks the mouse, permissions and protection strength
The status pill shows your mouse's real name and how it is connected
Calmer panel popup when the mouse is asleep; hover the icon to see the battery
Copy diagnostics: one click on About copies a privacy-safe report for bug reports
Works with screen readers and the keyboard, and follows GNOME's Large Text and Reduce Animation settings
The mouse is picked up the moment it wakes or is plugged in
The background service runs in a tight sandbox: read-only system and home folder, no network
Fixed: a click at the moment Wheelguard took over the mouse could leave the button stuck
Fixed: clicks and scrolls made while Wheelguard was starting could happen twice
Fixed: a broken config file or bad request could stop the scroll filter
Fixed: mouse settings could be saved only partly (Endgame sleep timer) or to an empty DPI stage (Logitech)
Fixed: the panel popup could show controls after the app had closed
Click-Lock: hold the left button and Wheelguard keeps clicking (or keeps it pressed) until your next click
Switch it, pick the mode and set the hold time from the panel popup or the Pointer page
New mice: Logitech G Pro X Superlight (first generation) and Razer DeathAdder V4 Pro
Fixed: the left button could stay pressed after the mouse woke up or reconnected
One package for every Fedora release, independent of the Python version
Signed packages from a DNF repository that keeps itself configured
The panel icon works on GNOME 51 (Fedora 45)
